Soft light from upper left, restrained warm ivory, muted sage and honey wood palette so a navy/blue-white character stands out. Keep the central and lower two thirds a spacious continuous pale warm stone or plaster floor with very subtle large-scale texture; no steps, paths that split it, obstacles or busy floor decoration. Three uncluttered areas near the upper left, upper right and lower right will later receive separately drawn work desk, rice table and resting cushion. The image itself fills the frame. NO people, animals, furniture, desk, table, chair, cushion, bowls, props, signs, letters, words, interface, status bars, buttons, decorative frame, game screenshot border, grid or watermark.
